prompts:
High-fidelity final UI visual concept for the Stella vertical touchscreen at an immersive VK exhibition stand. LANDSCAPE editorial contact sheet on warm off-white paper, three equal full 9:16 portrait screen panels, generous small outer margins, tiny captions outside screens. Flat actual UI artwork, not devices, no perspective, no hardware, no physical stand. Crisp high-resolution readable Cyrillic.

PRIMARY USER REQUIREMENT: Image1 is the protagonist identity reference, the living PIXEL RING which communicates with visitors. Preserve this specific image and recognizable identity on EVERY screen. It is the main interlocutor, never just background ornament. One large blue/cyan ring per screen, in upper-middle, 65–75% screen width, with clear dark hollow center and vertically feathered irregular cloud of evenly gridded rounded-square pixels. Small isolated bright square particles, softly radiant fluid density gathered into a ring, orthogonal fixed lattice, dark cell seams, sharp near cores and atmospheric bloom. No smooth glass donut, no thin circular outline, no eyeball/pupil, no face, no robot, no replacement by abstract waves, no several rings. The hollow center must remain open and dark. Ring reference governs identity over any stylistic defaults. Image2 is stand context (reference only), whose pixel-fluids are shared DNA. Broad fluid currents can continue behind and below UI but MUST NOT replace the ring or flatten it into a uniform grid wallpaper. Keep deep midnight navy space around UI. Ring must remain equally clear even during question and result. Static variations suggest breathing/listening/responding through slightly changing asymmetric light density; do not imply actual animation is demonstrated.
Hierarchy: modest official product logo at top on quiet solid navy strip, large ring around top 15–46% of screen, title near 48–57%, legible body/controls around 58–80%, generous bottom ambient space. Text and controls in front, never obscure ring's dark opening. Avoid overfilling or microscopic text. No mic, camera, QR or voice claim. Do not add captions inside UI beyond specified copy. Exact text in normal case except specified НАЧАТЬ. Keep branded logo inserts as provided, no redraw, no typed replacements, no distorted proportions or effects on logos. Branding is secondary to the pixel ring. This is a visual proposal; no implementation status text on artwork.
This board shows three key home/neutral communication states of the SAME ring. Title above sheet "Стела · кольцо-собеседник". Image3 official VK Видео logo and image4 official MAX logo are supporting insert assets.
Panel1 caption "01 / Приглашение": large ring bright blue asymmetrical breathing snapshot; below exact question "Что тебе\nсейчас ближе?" followed by two large equal-width stacked dark choice cards with exact official image logos VK Видео and MAX and small right arrows. No extra card subtitles. Restrained separate red/blue edge accents only on VK choice, cyan/violet on MAX choice. On neutral page don't invent a general VK logo. Top area clean, ring dominant.
Panel2 caption "02 / Вопрос": same neutral-blue ring with light concentrated on one side as if attending to visitor, exact question "Что тебе\nсейчас ближе?" below; same two cards, MAX card subtly lifted and illuminated violet to suggest touch focus. Ring maintains blue/cyan identity, edge fluid can pick up violet #6E1AFF. No cursor drawing, no human.
Panel3 caption "03 / Отклик": same recognizable blue ring with a denser clockwise bright arc and gently expanded pixel halo (still no smooth ring). Exact headline "Добро пожаловать\nв экосистему VK"; small "Здесь лента подстраивается под тебя"; large restrained matte violet-blue pill "НАЧАТЬ"; smaller "Назад". MAX official logo in solid quiet top-left header. Proposed response light, no unrelated sculptural portal.
Use pure blue/cyan core, near-black/navy backdrop, restrained violet around MAX, original red only inside VK logo/accent. Saturated cores without overexposure. All three ring centers remain dark open.

Panel2 caption "02 / Диалог": exact heading "Какие возможности\nты хочешь освоить?"; two wide stacked frosted pills "Для бизнеса" and "Для личного пользования", small simple white briefcase/chat glyph only INSIDE corresponding pill and slim arrow, then "Назад". Ring slightly asymmetric bright right sector as if asking, same center.
Panel3 caption "03 / Миссия": exact heading "Общение\nбез границ"; body "Попробуй все возможности\nобщения в MAX"; a clear right arrow beside instruction "Пройди к правой панели,\nчтобы начать"; wide frosted secondary pill "Подобрать другую миссию". Ring appears satisfied by brighter full fluid annulus, no added emoji. Do not claim result transmission implemented. Keep all text crisp and breathable, maintain consistent ring size/position across three states.

Panel2 caption "02 / Диалог": ring still big, slightly lower contrast outer pixels but bright core. First row selected blue border and small white check in blue circle. "Назад" below. Fit all text by reducing vertical gaps modestly, never shrinking ring to icon.
Panel3 caption "03 / Результат": bright responsive same pixel ring, title "Технология Discovery\nактивирована"; simple left arrow with instruction "Пройди к левой панели,\nчтобы посмотреть подборку"; solid red pill "спасибо".
